layers.process: Mayon Volcano, Albay: in its 7 November 2026 bulletin PHIVOLCS said entry into the six-kilometre-radius Permanent Danger Zone should not be allowed. The bulletin reported Alert Level 3 on that date. Volcanic conditions, exclusion areas and local orders can change rapidly: check the latest PHIVOLCS bulletin and local authority instructions immediately before planning any visit.
